anomalies_detected.description: A split-second flash of kernel text appeared during DRM master handoff on the `uefi_amd_gpu` profile. Mitigated by patching GRUB to append `vt.global_cursor_default=0` and modifying `snowos-splash` to hold the lease an extra 50ms.
Zero instances of black screens exceeding the 700ms budget. The cross-fade shader consistently masked the compositor init.
No screen tearing detected during the Wayland transition.
